info.title: ArtMostSphere API
info.description:
Africa's production OS HTTP API. Live catalog starts in Nigeria. Filter with state / city spatial context.

Auth is the httpOnly cookie `ams_session` (set by login/register) or `Authorization: Bearer`.
After **Auth → Login**, Scalar keeps the cookie for later calls on this origin.

Seed password for all demo users: `Lagos2026!`
